note: Round 8 is a development round on the exp87 build, run after exp86 passed at round 6 and before exp87's preregistration is frozen. items: tool outputs share one contract: facts (dominant change, more confident side, where differences concentrate, margin ratios, unused labels, whole-map estimate), must_state (at most three sentences) and forbidden_claims (fixed ids with the tool's reason)
a comparison counts where its differences sit (row and column bands) and moves its listing to a file; evidence is one sentence scoped to the case
statistical rules in code: the design records alpha, certification refuses another, next steps come from the design type

the answer is checked before it is shown (numbers, directions and places, claimed files and actions, forbidden claims), with one rewrite in REVISION_MODE and [unverified: <check>] marks on what still fails; a missing required statement is appended as 'Note from the tool:'
the loop runs as a middleware chain with LangChain 1.x's hook interface, behaviour-identical to the loop before it
